name: Availability Sync Menu Bar
description:
Availability Sync Menu Bar: Your Availability at a Glance

Tired of the endless back-and-forth when scheduling meetings? Meet Availability Sync, your new availability superpower!

Key Features:
	- Instant Availability View: See your free time slots at a glance, right from your menu bar.
	- Smart Calendar Integration: Seamlessly syncs with your existing calendars to show real-time 	availability.
	- One-Click Sharing: Share your available time slots effortlessly with colleagues or clients.
	- Quick Event Creation: Turn available slots into scheduled events with just a single click.


Availability Sync lives in your menu bar, always ready to showcase your availability and streamline your scheduling process. Whether you're a busy professional, a freelancer managing multiple clients, or anyone who values clear communication of their available time, AvailSync is your key to effortless scheduling.

Perfect for:
	- Professionals who need to quickly share their availability for team meetings
	- Freelancers coordinating client appointments across different time zones
	- Anyone looking to eliminate the "When are you free?" conversation

Why Availability Sync?
	- Always Accessible: Your availability is just a click away in your menu bar.
	- Real-Time Updates: As your schedule changes, so does your displayed availability.
	- Customizable Time Slots: Set your working hours and preferred meeting durations.
	- Multi-Calendar Support: Aggregate availability across personal and work calendars.

Say goodbye to availability confusion and hello to clearer, more productive scheduling. Download AvailSync for Mac today and transform the way you communicate your available time!
